releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.212: Update Check refresh now restores the Diary Me menu after the verified web bundle reload. Existing APK download/install and web update verification flows are unchanged. Includes Web Update 383. Existing notes, photos, PINs, locks, widgets, and saved data are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Web Update 386: Corrected Update Report so it appears inside the existing Me menu in the exact same area, replacing the Me options until × is tapped. The report is restored after the updater refreshes the WebView. Copy and × remain the only report actions; the existing native download, verification, and installation flow is preserved.
